The per-wallet tape was captured from GMGN's 1h Smart Inflow table (Monitor > Smart / Callout at https://gmgn.ai/monitor?chain=sol&tab=smartdegen), not from token-level S-Flow aggregates. The left-rail Smart Degen mini feed was not used as the tape (it was used only to resolve full wallet addresses when a visible /sol/address/<FULL> href matched a board label by first 4 and last 4 characters). The board is a set of per-token cards, each listing up to 3 wallet rows, and it reorders every few seconds. Pass-1 cards that later scrolled out of the DOM kept their first-read rows. Later passes added only rows not already seen (wallet+token+action+usd+CA). Two extraction runs were merged (run A: passes 1–3 on the first load; run B: passes 1–4 including a reload), deduplicated by wallet+action+usd+CA, for 93 unique captured rows.
